name: IndexGrid
definition: A novel sparse data structure derived from NanoVDB, designed with a re-imagined programming and execution model to aggressively accelerate stencil-centric operations (e.g., convolution) while serving as an effective acceleration structure for ray marching and other spatial operations.
summary: IndexGrid is a sparse data structure that accelerates volume rendering by separating topology from values, achieving O(1) access and 50x memory reduction compared to standard VDB.
